question: Will the IOM Missing Migrants Project record at least 2,500 Mediterranean migrant deaths in 2026?

calls.reasoning: MMP Mediterranean 2026 YTD shows 2,045 (latest incident 23 Oct 2026); about 455 more are needed by 31 Dec, i.e. ~6.6/day over ~69 days. The count was ~1,000 by 7 Apr, so the average since April is ~5.25/day, which projects to ~2,400 at year end. Central Med deaths nearly stalled from mid-Sept to mid-Oct (996->1,006) while the Eastern Med rose (417->521). Upside: lumpy mass-casualty wrecks (a 100+ event is plausible in Nov-Dec), backfilling of late-Oct incidents, and entries up to the 10 Jan cutoff. Downside: winter weather means fewer departures, and arrivals are down ~36-55%. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- MMP Mediterranean page/homepage (fetched 2026-11-03): 2026 Mediterranean dead+missing = 2,045; latest incident recorded 23 Oct 2026.
- MMP data page annual Mediterranean totals (current, post-revision): 2025 2,185; 2024 2,573; 2023 3,155; 2022 2,411; 2021 2,048; 2020 1,450; 2019 1,885; 2018 2,337; 2017 3,139. The 2025 total was reported as ~2,108 in early Jan 2026, so the Jan snapshot sits below the final figure.
- IOM news, 7 Apr 2026: Mediterranean 2026 toll nearing 1,000; Central Med ~765 (vs ~300 same period 2025). The implied average 7 Apr -> 23 Oct is ~5.25/day.
- IOM news, 17 Sep 2026: Jan to mid-Sept deaths Central Med 996, Eastern Med 417, Atlantic+Western Med 879 (all-routes total 2,292). Arrivals down 39%.
- Kurdistan24 citing IOM, Jan 1 -> Oct 12 2026: Central Med deaths 1,006 (vs 921 in 2025), Eastern Med 521 (vs 295); all-routes incl. Atlantic 2,437 (vs 2,237). Central Med added only ~10 between mid-Sept and 12 Oct; Eastern Med added ~104.
- InfoMigrants, 8 Jul 2026: H1 2026 sea deaths 1,570 (incl. Atlantic) vs 1,232 in H1 2025; an estimated ~1,000 may have died during Cyclone Harry in January, largely not verified/counted.
- News search, early Nov 2026: no major Mediterranean shipwreck with large tolls found for late Oct / 1-3 Nov; 130 migrants landed in Lampedusa on 1 Nov.
- Requirement: +455 between 23 Oct and 31 Dec (about 69 days, ~6.6/day), recorded by the 10 Jan 2027 cutoff. Single Central Med wrecks of 50-180 dead/missing occurred several times in 2026 (e.g. early April).
- Status quo: continuing the post-April average gives roughly 2,400 by year end.
- Resolves off the MMP 'Mediterranean' region YTD 2026 figure (excludes the Atlantic/Canary route), not the IOM all-routes 'Europe' totals.
- Event window: 2026-01-01 -> 2026-12-31 (data up to 10 Jan 2027); as of 2026-11-03 about 84% elapsed.
- Markets: none found (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi/bookmakers).
- Searched but not found: Western Med 2026 sub-total; Mediterranean YTD at end-Oct 2025 for direct seasonal comparison.
calls.reference_class: Past MMP Mediterranean years: share of the annual total recorded after late October (typically ~15-22%), and the 2026 run-rate since April

calls.reasoning: MMP Mediterranean 2026 = 2,045 as of the latest incident on 23 Oct; 455 more are needed by 31 Dec and must be recorded by the 10 Jan cutoff. The most recent month added only ~74 (1,971 on 24 Sep -> 2,045 on 23 Oct). Winter seasonality and arrivals down 36-39% point to roughly 150-300 more, landing ~2,200-2,350. YES needs one or two 100+ mass-casualty wrecks or a large backfill. Runs 1 and 3 projected the post-April average, which includes the summer peak, and so overstate the pace. 2026's high lethality keeps the tail meaningful. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: Main dispute (judgment, informed by fact): which pace to project. Runs 1 and 3 used the post-April average (~5.3/day, which includes the summer peak); Run 2 used the most recent month (~74 from 24 Sep to 23 Oct). Checks: the MMP page fetch confirmed only the 'latest incident 23 Oct 2026' line (the 2026 total was not parsed). A search found the 'more than 1,970 by late September' figure, consistent with Run 2's monthly pace. A news search found no major Mediterranean wreck in Nov 2026; the October Djibouti wreck is off-route. Statista monthly data is paywalled, so the historical Nov-Dec increment was not settled and rests on recall. The 2025 Jan-snapshot vs final revision (~2,108 -> 2,185) suggests post-cutoff additions are excluded. I side with the seasonal, recent-pace reading and keep a fat tail for mass-casualty wrecks.
